english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial verb for writing something down so you will remember it.
Use this when recording information means writing it down or making a note for later reference.
Use 記低 for recording something in writing or jotting it down.

examples.english: Please note down the phone number for me.
examples.traditional: 你幫我記低個電話號碼，唔該。
examples.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 gei3 dai1 go3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 m4 goi1

examples.english: Tell me the address and I'll record it for later.
examples.jyutping: nei5 gong2 go3 dei6 zi2 ngo5 gei3 dai1 sin1

examples.english: Tell me the phone number, and I’ll register it right away.
examples.traditional: 你講個電話號碼，我即刻記低。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gong2 go3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 ngo5 zik1 hak1 gei3 dai1
